tts: This program does a quick quality check on six tablets from one batch.
import numpy as N P loads NumPy, under the short name N P.
The comment says these are tablet weights in milligrams.
N P dot array turns the list of six weights into a NumPy array, called w.
w dot mean adds all six weights and divides by six. The average is exactly five hundred.
min and max give the lightest and heaviest tablets: four eighty eight and five ten.
This mask keeps tablets below four ninety, or above five ten. Each condition is in brackets, joined by the bar sign, which means or.
Only one tablet, four eighty eight milligrams, is outside the limit.

tts: The array holds three doses in milligrams, side by side.
Dividing the array by a thousand divides every item at the same time. There is no loop.
